edges.evidence: Transport reduces travel friction; timing is strategic, not a hard requirement.
Fossil Island contains birdhouse trapping.
Passive Hunter experience contributes to Hunter level.
Supply outputs may contribute but do not independently establish combat readiness.
Potential GP pipeline; exact timing and amount are strategic.
Fairy-ring access enables the Enchanted Valley tree-spirit acquisition path; rate validation remains pending.
Fossil Island access enables the underwater seaweed patches.
Pandemonium is the Sailing entry quest and grants Sailing skill access.
Sailing skill access enables Sailing activities; individual content retains its own requirements.
A skiff is purchased within the Sailing system after its entry quest; the 15,000-coin purchase cost remains an external resource requirement.
Skiff ownership requires at least 15 Sailing.
A realised one-handed stab weapon can affect combat capability; readiness remains account-specific.
Transport networks combine to reduce movement cost; neither is a hard requirement for the other.
Varlamore access is needed for the Hunters' Guild.
A GP-producing activity can finance rune and shop needs without prescribing a universal cash grind.
Candidate cash pipeline for Kingdom funding; current yield validation remains pending.
Completing Troubled Tortugans grants Great Conch docking and Gryphon access.
Great Conch access requires at least 45 Sailing.
Port Roberts docking requires at least 50 Sailing.
Wyrmscraig docking requires at least 62 Sailing.
Wyrmscraig access permits starting Fallen From Grace; the quest retains its own skill requirements.
Completing Fallen From Grace unlocks Sunstone Golem Crafting.
Sunstone Golem Crafting has a one-in-300 Jeweller's Chisel reward chance.
Great Conch access includes the Shellbane Gryphon cave; repeat kills retain their Slayer-task gate.
Shellbane Gryphon has a one-in-256 chance to drop Belle's Folly (tarnished).
The tarnished weapon is the required input for Belle's Folly repair.
Belle's Folly is repaired at the Giants' Foundry polishing wheel.
Repairing Belle's Folly requires at least 70 Smithing.
Bounty tasks provide Sailing experience and coins.
Vale Totems provides Vale Research Points and a random-reward acquisition path.
The Fletching Knife affects Vale Totems and other supported repeated Fletching actions.
All-style offensive bonuses can improve account combat capability; readiness remains account-specific.
Golden nuggets are random sack rewards after cleaned pay-dirt, at a 3.13% rate per pay-dirt.
The upper level is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase, subject to 57 Mining.
The super hopper is a guaranteed 50-golden-nugget purchase after the upper level is unlocked.
The pay-dirt sack upgrade is a guaranteed 200-golden-nugget purchase.
The Prospector kit is a guaranteed 180-golden-nugget purchase.
The coal bag is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase.
The gem bag is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase.
Motherlode Mine's upper level requires at least 57 Mining.
The super hopper requires the Motherlode Mine upper level.
Motherlode Mine's lower level requires at least 30 Mining.
A one-handed melee weapon with slash and crush capability can alter account combat readiness; exact timing is strategic.
The Restless Ghost is a direct Nature Spirit quest prerequisite.
Priest in Peril is a direct Nature Spirit quest prerequisite.
Nature Spirit is a direct Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest prerequisite.
Lost City is a direct Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest prerequisite.
Completing Fairytale I permits starting Fairytale II and reaching the Fairy Godfather permission checkpoint.
Lost City provides the Dramen-staff path, which fulfils the wielded staff condition; a Lunar staff is an alternative staff item.
Fairy-ring permission is required for usable transport but is not sufficient by itself.
With permission, a wielded Dramen or Lunar staff is required to use fairy rings unless the elite diary exception is complete.
Lumbridge & Draynor Elite Diary removes the staff-equipment requirement; fairy-ring permission remains required.
The Dig Site enables the Museum specimen-cleaning contribution toward the permanent Kudos counter.
The Dig Site is a direct Bone Voyage quest prerequisite.
Bone Voyage requires at least 100 Museum Kudos; Kudos are a permanent non-spendable counter and are not consumed.
Completing Bone Voyage grants permanent Fossil Island access via the Digsite barge.
Farming contracts can reward Hespori seeds.
Hespori has a one-in-35 Bottomless compost bucket drop.
Herb storage can reduce inventory friction in herb-gathering Hunter content; exact timing is strategic.
Piety improves general melee capability; Moons' unique mechanics still require individual readiness assessment.
The defender's melee bonuses can improve combat readiness without being a hard requirement.
Heroes' Quest is a direct Throne of Miscellania prerequisite.
The Fremennik Trials is a direct Throne of Miscellania prerequisite.
Throne of Miscellania unlocks Kingdom management and seeds its coffer with 10,000 coins.
Throne of Miscellania is the direct Royal Trouble prerequisite.
Royal Trouble expands Kingdom management to 15 workers, raises its coffer and daily wage caps, and adds labour categories.
Rune Mysteries is the prerequisite for the Enter the Abyss miniquest.
Completing Enter the Abyss is a hard Temple of the Eye prerequisite.
Temple of the Eye requires at least 10 Runecraft.
Completing Temple of the Eye permanently unlocks Guardians of the Rift access.
Guardians of the Rift requires at least 27 Runecraft.
Any pickaxe is required to participate in Guardians of the Rift.
Elemental energy awards elemental reward points at the end of a game.
Catalytic energy awards catalytic reward points at the end of a game.
Each Rewards Guardian search consumes one elemental point.
Each Rewards Guardian search consumes one catalytic point.
A Rewards Guardian search has a one-in-seven chance to award 14-16 abyssal pearls; pearls are not guaranteed per search.
The one-in-300 abyssal-needle search roll is a random alternative to buying one with accumulated pearls.
The one-in-700 abyssal-lantern search roll is a random alternative to buying one with accumulated pearls.
Each Raiments piece is a guaranteed Temple Supplies purchase once its abyssal-pearl cost is held.
The Ring of the elements is a guaranteed 400-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase.
The abyssal needle is a guaranteed 750-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase once the pearls are accumulated.
The abyssal lantern is a guaranteed 1,500-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase once the pearls are accumulated.
Creating a colossal pouch requires an abyssal needle.
Creating a colossal pouch requires at least 25 unboosted Runecraft.
Creating a colossal pouch requires at least 56 unboosted Crafting.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the small pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the medium pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the large pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the giant pouch.
Tithe Farm points are earned deterministically from deposited plants.
Tithe Farm requires at least 34 Farming.
Auto-weed is a guaranteed 50-point Tithe Farm purchase.
Sleeping Giants requires at least 15 Smithing.
Completing Sleeping Giants permanently unlocks Giants' Foundry.
A Foundry commission requires metal inputs worth at least two bars plus a bucket or ice gloves for the moulded weapon.
Completed Giants' Foundry commissions award Foundry Reputation based on final sword quality.
The double ammo mould is a guaranteed 2,000-reputation shop purchase, with Dwarf Cannon also required.
Purchasing the double ammo mould also requires Dwarf Cannon completion.
Smiths' uniform pieces are guaranteed Foundry Reputation shop purchases.
The permanent Foundry mould library is a guaranteed reputation purchase.
Successful Tempoross encounters earn reward permits at their stated full point thresholds.
Tempoross requires at least 35 Fishing.
Each reward permit is consumed for one Tempoross reward-pool roll.
The Fish Barrel is a one-in-400 Tempoross reward-pool roll and is not guaranteed after any number of permits.
